sources.notes: Basic-rule Q&A displayed 2017-03-24. The question explicitly concerns simultaneous sending by one effect. Use that bounded statement for the ownership principle; do not claim it directly addresses Chain-end cleanup.
Current OCG basic-rule Q&A displayed 2017-03-24: preserve order after placement; not an authenticated original TCG 2005 ruling.

Current OCG example displayed 2017-09-28: used Counter Traps stay out of the GY until Chain completion, while a negated/destroyed Counter already leaves. Minerva, Divine Punishment, Forcefield and other example cards remain unsupported; their trigger behavior is not adopted.

Retailer/community Chain explanation explicitly describes used Spell/Trap cards sent simultaneously by rules at Chain end. Not a Konami ruling or an authenticated period TCG source. Use with the archived Goat cleanup statement and official Counter example, not alone.

Current community wiki. Its FAQ annotates the general owner-order statement (10/01/07); that date is a community annotation, not independently authenticated historical publication. Only the general ownership statement is used; modern Xyz/equip/game-software examples are excluded.

Previously frozen on 2026-10-27, reviewed locally on 2026-10-29. Preserve the source editorial caveat about recent rule changes; no claim of a new live fetch. Re-reviewed locally on 2026-10-30 for the three-link design; prior retrieval date retained. Re-read locally on 2026-10-30 for the cleanup-order addendum; original retrieval date preserved.

Seven Tools subsection explicitly labelled Netrep Rulings; distinguishes Trap card activation from an already active Continuous Trap effect. Not an authenticated original UDE bulletin. Ultimate Offering stays unsupported. Re-reviewed locally on 2026-10-30 for the three-link design; prior retrieval date retained. Re-read locally on 2026-10-30 for the cleanup-order addendum; original retrieval date preserved.

evidence.quotation: 一つの効果処理にて、一度に複数のカードが同時に墓地へ送られる事になる場合、それらのカードを墓地へ置く順番は、その墓地へ送られるカードの持ち主が選ぶ事ができます。
evidence.historicalApplicability: Official ownership/ordering principle for simultaneous cards sent by one effect. Chain-end cleanup is a rules action, so its application there is a synthesis with the general community rule and simultaneous-cleanup sources, not a direct quotation about cleanup.

evidence.quotation: なお、その効果処理を行ったカードは一番最後に墓地へ送られる事になりますので、
evidence.historicalApplicability: Example distinguishes effect-destroyed monsters from the effect source sent after processing. Do not extrapolate that the root Spell must be last among all surviving Spell/Trap sources in a multi-link Chain.

evidence.quotation: デュエル中に墓地へ送られたカードの順番を、プレイヤーが任意に入れ替える事はできません。
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current baseline: ordering newly sent cards does not authorize rearranging cards already in the GY.

evidence.quotation: 墓地に送られたカードは、墓地に送られた順番のままでデュエルを進行します。
evidence.historicalApplicability: Preserve established GY order. Previously paid discard, destroyed Magic Jammer and root-effect victims are outside the later cleanup batch.

evidence.quotation: 最後にチェーン処理が終了し、発動した「フォースフィールド」と「神罰」は墓地へ送られる事になります。
evidence.historicalApplicability: Official Counter example corroborates deferred cleanup. No Minerva/Counter-trigger support, fourth link or example-card import is enabled.

quotations.locator: Chain explanation, paragraph after the three-link example

evidence.quotation: また、その一連のチェーンが全て終了したタイミングで、ルールによって全て同時に墓地へ送られるので、「チェーン処理の最中は魔法＆罠ゾーンにこれらの使用済みカードは存在し続けている」ことになります。
evidence.historicalApplicability: Community statement explicitly supplies simultaneity of normal Chain-end cleanup. Apply only to sources that remain to be cleaned up; a source already destroyed in the Chain is excluded.

evidence.quotation: 複数枚のカードが同時に墓地へ送られる場合、カードの持ち主が墓地に置く順番を決定します。
evidence.historicalApplicability: General community formulation for simultaneous sends, corroborated for a specific effect by official FAQ 206. Not represented as an authenticated TCG 2005 bulletin.

evidence.quotation: また、自分で発動したカードでも、相手が発動したカードでも、墓地に置く順番を決定するプレイヤーは、墓地へ送られるカードの持ち主になります。
evidence.historicalApplicability: Order within one GY belongs to the card owner. Do not give a counter/effect controller permission to reorder another player’s batch.

evidence.quotation: if a general rule is not explicitly listed here is being different in Goat Format, you can assume that it works the exact same way as it does in the current format.

evidence.quotation: Spell and Trap Cards remain on the field until the entire chain resolves, unless destroyed by a card effect during the chain.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Community transcription of a period FAQ, not an authenticated original UDE bulletin. Distinguishes normal Chain-end cleanup from Magic Jammer destroyed immediately by Seven Tools. Stamping Destruction remains unsupported.

implementationContract.scope: the bounded three-link Normal Spell -> Magic Jammer -> Seven Tools design only; do not silently change other handlers
implementationContract.sameOwnerTwoSources: require a genuine order choice with both permutations; source/instance identity, not card name
implementationContract.splitOwners: one source per owner needs no order-choice UI; preserve each independent GY order
implementationContract.earlierSends: paid discard, Magic Jammer destroyed by Seven Tools and root-effect victims remain in chronological positions below the later batch
implementationContract.choiceTiming: after all link effects/mandatory root effect-choice complete; before cleanup/post-chain response. No new Chain responses while ordering
implementationContract.protocol: server-owned cleanup context; strict ordered-permutation validation and opaque current-viewer/state-version handles. Existing answer-decision optionIds can carry order but current UI/decision kinds must be extended before use
implementationContract.privateView: owner gets only their batch/order controls; do not serialize raw frame, raw IDs or unrelated hidden cards
implementationContract.idempotency: receipt retry must neither append sources again nor recreate/reorder a completed batch
implementationContract.terminal: no pending ordering decision after LP defeat/failed draw/concession; explicitly reconcile with the project terminal-state policy in implementation, do not claim that internal cleanup bookkeeping is an additional game action

notImplemented: General mixed Chains, triggers, replacements, fourth Counter link
Global graveyard reorder, opponent-batch control, custom cards or beta packaging
